# i.cs.hku.hk

> Research and academic hub at the University of Hong Kong's Department of Computer Science, featuring multimedia laboratory and distributed systems projects.

i.cs.hku.hk hosts research centers and projects within HKU's computer science department, including the Multimedia Laboratory and various funded research initiatives. The site serves as a repository for academic research, project documentation, and institutional resources.

## Key Topics

- Multimedia Laboratory
- University of Hong Kong
- Computer Science
- Distributed Retrieval
- Surveillance Systems
- Research Laboratory
- Large-Scale Architecture
- Center for Information Security and Cryptography (CISC)
- Innovation and Technology Fund (ITF)
- Academic Institution
- Project Documentation

## Research Centers

- [Multimedia Laboratory](https://i.cs.hku.hk/~mmlab/): Multimedia Laboratory at University of Hong Kong research center homepage

## Research Projects

- [A Distributed Retrieval Architecture for Large Scale Surveillance System (ITS/050/07)](https://i.cs.hku.hk/~cisc/projects/ITS05007/sponsorship.html): Sponsorship documentation for CISC distributed surveillance system project
